case_title: Pramod Kumar Mishra v. The State of U.P.
mitigating_circumstances: Old enmity, no criminal antecedents, no premeditation
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 307 IPC, sentenced to 5 years rigorous imprisonment
neutral_facts: The prosecution case is that on 12 August 1984, the victim was returning to his house when he saw the accused and other co-accused persons destroying crops in his field. The victim intervened, which led to the accused persons attacking him with weapons, resulting in injuries and unconsciousness. An FIR was registered against the accused. The investigation concluded with a chargesheet, and the trial court convicted one accused under Section 307 IPC and sentenced him to 5 years rigorous imprisonment. The other accused were acquitted. The High Court affirmed the conviction and sentence.
